items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
Drives motorized equipment: Yes
Minimum of 2 - 4 years of related experience.

Regularly communicates with organization's customers, reduces risk to the University by ensuring departmental compliance with procurement policy, and works in conjunction with end-users to develop specifications for Request for Quotes (RFQs) or requesting additional information that is required by the CIO or CISO. Manage campus-wide hardware and software approval process - All POs for software and hardware must be reviewed and approved by the CIO. This position will provide information needed to CIO to make a decision on the software/hardware item, follow-up with the department when additional information is needed, follow-up with the CIO to ensure approval or denial is received in a timely manner, notify department of approval or denial. In addition, work with ITS' security group to obtain whether hardware and software is approved security wise and based upon the software/hardware data classification and protection levels (P1, P2, P3, P4...). Follow-up with departments if an Appendix DS is required and/or if additional information is needed. Furthermore, follow-up with IT Security group to ensure approvals or denials are made in a timely manner and communicate the decision to campus departments. (30% time)

Drafts and executes purchase orders, utlizing standard terms and conditions for materials, supplies, equipment, and services. Drafts requests for quotations (RFQs) including specifications and terms and conditions. (5% time)
Develops spreadsheets and other documentation to support analysis (5% time)
Interprets and applies basic University polices and procedures. (5% time)
Negotiates with suppliers for lower prices and better terms and helps resolve supplier performance issues. (5% time)
Performs cost analyses and reviews terms and conditions for appropriateness. Makes awards based on cost and specification requirements. (5% time)
Under general supervision, provides analysis of moderate purchasing projects. (5% time)

Acquires and maintains a basic technical understanding of commonly purchased products. In addition, receives packages, verifies contents of packages against packing list/purchase order and notifies ITS staff when packages arrive. (5% time)
Participates in professional development and training. (5% time)
Maintains both office and sanitization supplies inventory and order supplies as needed. Submits, tracks, and follows-up on facilities work orders for the C&C Bldg. (5% time)

Represents ITS as first point of contact for the Computing & Communications Bldg. (C&C). Greets visitors and directs them to their proper contact within ITS and assists guests with procuring guest parking passes for Lot 9. (5% time)

Manages ITS golf carts and check-out system. Unlocks golf cart shed each morning and ensures the carts are in the shed, plugged into the chargers, and the shed is locked at the end of each day. Reports any golf cart issues to supervisor. (5% time)

Ensures the copy/mail room is kept in a clean state (e.g. emptying shredder, throwing away paper or print jobs that haven't been picked up, etc.) and performs minor troubleshooting on printers and copiers. Notifies supervisor if a technician is required for repair. (5% time)

Keeps C&C Bldg. conference and huddle rooms presentable and assists with minor troubleshooting of equipment in conference and huddle rooms. Reports any trouble with equipment to Multimedia and Classroom Technology group. (5% time)
Point of contact for freight carriers (ex. Fed Ex / UPS) and arranges Fed Ex / UPS shipments as required. (5% time)
CA Driver's License

Working level of proficiency in the use of standard spreadsheet and word processing software.
Some knowledge of ITS departments and operations required in order to meet their procurement needs.
Analytical skills necessary to evaluate the quality and cost effectiveness of purchasing options.

Ability to read and interpret terms and conditions of basic contracts.
Demonstrated knowledge of UCOP's system-wide IT contracts.
